name: token-input
title: Token Input
description: UI SDK Token Input styled as a field: removable token chips with undo, Backspace and arrow keys, and a labels mode where Enter or a comma commits and a paste splits; agents set it by label.
docs: `<TokenInput tokenType="label" value onValueChange validate max tone labels>` with a `<TokenInputEditor placeholder>` child, inside a `Field` or `FormField`: a list of labels as removable chips. Enter or a comma turns the typed text into a label, a paste splits on commas and line breaks, Backspace removes the chip before the caret and Ctrl/Cmd+Z brings it back. The value is `string[]` (readonly arrays welcome). Without `tokenType`, the value is UI SDK's mix of text and tokens (`TokenInputValue`), for mentions or files: pass `renderToken` and a `TriggerMenu` child as UI SDK documents. The remove buttons are pointer-only and named by `labels.remove` ("Remove {label}").
